caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a reddish-brown rim and a decorative design in the center. The main element on the plate is a stylized bird, likely a peacock, oriented to the right, with a long neck, thin legs, and a fan-shaped tail. The bird is colored primarily in green with accents of red, yellow, and brown. The bird's body features patterns including horizontal green lines and green spots, and it has a red circular patch on its side. On the left side of the plate, there are large, red and green stylized leaves and a flower, with curving stems. In the upper right section of the plate, there is a banner or scroll motif with the text "1832 AER" written on it. Green spots are scattered across the background of the plate’s design. Below the circular image, there is a drawing of the plate's side profile, showing a shallow, wide shape with a reddish hue matching the rim of the plate. The entire composition is executed on a plain, beige background.
title: Plate
